question: For which of the following films did K Mahashweta win the Young Actress / Best Child award at the Las Vegas Movie Awards 2020 for her role in a short film?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GrandmaToy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tiruppur-based K Mahashweta **received **praise **for **her work in a short film**` at the **2020 Las Vegas Movie Awards**.
 
• **K Mahashweta**, a **Class V student **in **Tiruppur **who is **ten years old**, has **appeared in four Malayalam short films **and has **already won two international acting awards**.
 
• For her **work in the short film Grandma Toy**, she most recently **won the Best Child/Young Actress prize**.
